findings.title: Couldn't confirm: Temperature rating (T)
findings.detail: Doors must have a fire resistance rating of at least 3 hours for heavy duty applications per CSA standards.
findings.why_it_matters: Fire-rated doors protect lives and property during a fire event.
findings.spec_ref: 08 71 00 2.3 Performance Requirements/Standards .1 CSA for Heavy Duty.

findings.title: grade level
findings.detail: Package states Grade 1; spec requires exactly 1.
findings.spec_ref: 08 71 00 2.3 Performance Requirements/Standards .2 All hardware to be Grade 1.

findings.title: Couldn't confirm: lock cylinder brand
findings.detail: Lock cylinders must be Abloy of Canada brand with no substitutions allowed.
findings.why_it_matters: Using the specified brand ensures compatibility and security performance as required.
findings.spec_ref: 08 71 00 3.1 Product Selection .1 Materials .1 Lock Cylinders .1 Abloy of Canada Cylinders – no substitutions allowed.

findings.title: Couldn't confirm: hinge brands
findings.detail: Hinges must be from approved brands: Stanley, Monthard, Hager, or McKinney.
findings.why_it_matters: Approved hinges ensure proper door function and durability under heavy use.
findings.spec_ref: 08 71 00 3.1 Product Selection .1 Materials .2 Hinges .1 Stanley/Monthard/Hager/McKinney.

findings.title: Couldn't confirm: pivot brands
findings.detail: If pivots are used, they must be from Dorma or Yale-Corbin (Rixson).
findings.why_it_matters: Specified pivots are tested for reliability in the intended application.
findings.spec_ref: 08 71 00 3.1 Product Selection .1 Materials .3 Pivots – (Only if needed as this is not UBC preferred hardware). .1 Dorma. .2 Yale - Corbin (Rixson).

findings.title: Couldn't confirm: door stop brands
findings.detail: Door stops, swing stops, and holders must be from approved brands: Rixson, Dorma, Hagar, Gallery, Ives, Glynn–Johnson, or Rockwood.
findings.why_it_matters: Approved door stops prevent damage and ensure proper door operation.
findings.spec_ref: 08 71 00 3.1 Product Selection .1 Materials .4 Door Stops, Swing Stops, and Holders .1 Rixson/Dorma/Hagar/Gallery/Ives/Glynn–Johnson/Rockwood.

findings.title: Couldn't confirm: flush bolt brands
findings.detail: Flush bolts must be from approved brands: Trimco, Ives, Glynn-Johnson, Gallery, or Rockwood.
findings.why_it_matters: Specified flush bolts provide reliable secondary locking where needed.
findings.spec_ref: 08 71 00 3.1 Product Selection .1 Materials .5 Flush Bolts .1 Trimco/Ives/Glynn-Johnson/Gallery/Rockwood.

findings.title: Couldn't confirm: mortise lock series
findings.detail: Mortise locks must be from specified series: Corbin ML2000, Schlage L9000, or Sargent 8200.
findings.why_it_matters: Approved mortise lock series ensure strength and compatibility with door preparations.
findings.spec_ref: 08 71 00 3.1 Product Selection .1 Materials .6 Mortise Locks and Trim .1 Corbin ML2000 series with LWA lever. .2 Schlage L9000 series with 03B lever. .3 Sargent 8200 series with LNJ lever.

findings.title: Does not meet: cylindrical lock series
findings.detail: Package states ND Series; allowed: Corbin CL3300, Schlage ND, Sargent 10, LSDA-800.
findings.why_it_matters: The lock series must match the approved list to ensure proper function, security, and keying compatibility.
findings.spec_ref: 08 71 00 3.1 Product Selection .1 Materials .7 Cylindrical Locks .1 Corbin CL3300 series .2 Schlage ND series with Vandlguard .3 Sargent 10 line .4 LSDA-800 series Grade 2 levers.

requirements.paragraph: 2.3 Performance Requirements/Standards .1 CSA for Heavy Duty.
requirements.text: Doors must have a fire resistance rating of at least 3 hours for heavy duty applications per CSA standards.

requirements.paragraph: 2.3 Performance Requirements/Standards .2 All hardware to be Grade 1.
requirements.text: All hardware must be ANSI/BHMA Grade 1.

requirements.paragraph: 3.1 Product Selection .1 Materials .1 Lock Cylinders .1 Abloy of Canada Cylinders – no substitutions allowed.
requirements.text: Lock cylinders must be Abloy of Canada brand with no substitutions allowed.

requirements.paragraph: 3.1 Product Selection .1 Materials .2 Hinges .1 Stanley/Monthard/Hager/McKinney.
requirements.text: Hinges must be from approved brands: Stanley, Monthard, Hager, or McKinney.

requirements.paragraph: 3.1 Product Selection .1 Materials .3 Pivots – (Only if needed as this is not UBC preferred hardware). .1 Dorma. .2 Yale - Corbin (Rixson).
requirements.text: If pivots are used, they must be from Dorma or Yale-Corbin (Rixson).

requirements.paragraph: 3.1 Product Selection .1 Materials .4 Door Stops, Swing Stops, and Holders .1 Rixson/Dorma/Hagar/Gallery/Ives/Glynn–Johnson/Rockwood.
requirements.text: Door stops, swing stops, and holders must be from approved brands: Rixson, Dorma, Hagar, Gallery, Ives, Glynn–Johnson, or Rockwood.

requirements.paragraph: 3.1 Product Selection .1 Materials .5 Flush Bolts .1 Trimco/Ives/Glynn-Johnson/Gallery/Rockwood.
requirements.text: Flush bolts must be from approved brands: Trimco, Ives, Glynn-Johnson, Gallery, or Rockwood.

requirements.paragraph: 3.1 Product Selection .1 Materials .6 Mortise Locks and Trim .1 Corbin ML2000 series with LWA lever. .2 Schlage L9000 series with 03B lever. .3 Sargent 8200 series with LNJ lever.
requirements.text: Mortise locks must be from specified series: Corbin ML2000, Schlage L9000, or Sargent 8200.

requirements.paragraph: 3.1 Product Selection .1 Materials .7 Cylindrical Locks .1 Corbin CL3300 series .2 Schlage ND series with Vandlguard .3 Sargent 10 line .4 LSDA-800 series Grade 2 levers.
requirements.text: Cylindrical locks must be from specified series: Corbin CL3300, Schlage ND, Sargent 10, or LSDA-800 Grade 2 levers.

requirements.paragraph: 3.1 Product Selection .1 Materials .8 Push Button Code Locks .1 Schlage CO 100 x less cylinder x KP x 626 .2 Sargent KP Series
requirements.text: Push button code locks must be Schlage CO 100 or Sargent KP series.

requirements.paragraph: 3.1 Product Selection .1 Materials .9 Alarm Locks .1 Stand-alone systems: Detex EAX500 or Alarm Lock Pilfergard PG21 .2 Panic Bar Style (must re-latch): Sargent, Von Duprin, Corbin, Alarm Lock, Detex
requirements.text: Alarm locks must be Detex EAX500, Alarm Lock Pilfergard PG21 for stand-alone, or Sargent, Von Duprin, Corbin, Alarm Lock, Detex for panic bar style (must re-latch).

requirements.paragraph: 3.1 Product Selection .1 Materials .10 Dead Bolt Locks .1 Mortise: Corbin DL4000 series, Sargent 4800 series, Schlage L600 series. .2 Cylindrical: ILCO 4514.25.1.04.04.5
requirements.text: Dead bolt locks must be mortise (Corbin DL4000, Sargent 4800, Schlage L600) or cylindrical (ILCO 4514.25.1.04.04.5).

requirements.paragraph: 3.1 Product Selection .1 Materials .11 Magnetic Locks .1 Magnetic locks are not acceptable and should only be used when required by code. .2 Securitron M Series (if required)
requirements.text: Magnetic locks are not acceptable unless required by code; if used, must be Securitron M Series.

requirements.paragraph: 3.1 Product Selection .1 Materials .12 Exit Devices .1 Von Duprin 98XP and 99XP series, and 33A series. .2 Sargent 8000 series. .3 Corbin ED5000 series
requirements.text: Exit devices must be from specified series: Von Duprin 98XP, 99XP, 33A; Sargent 8000; or Corbin ED5000.

requirements.paragraph: 3.1 Product Selection .1 Materials .13 Door Closers .1 LCN 4040XP Series x 689 finish. .2 Sargent 351 .3 Corbin 6200 / Norton 7700 .4 Floor closers are “not” acceptable at UBC.
requirements.text: Door closers must be LCN 4040XP, Sargent 351, Corbin 6200, or Norton 7700; floor closers are not acceptable.

requirements.paragraph: 3.1 Product Selection .1 Materials .14 Power Operators and Electrified Closers .1 LCN 4630/4640 Series - "Auto Equalizer" x 689 finish. .2 Record-8100 Series and Record-Simple Swing units. .3 No substitutions allowed.
requirements.text: Power operators and electrified closers must be LCN 4630/4640 Auto Equalizer, Record-8100, or Record-Simple Swing; no substitutions allowed.

requirements.paragraph: 3.1 Product Selection .1 Materials .15 Automatic Door Opener Push Plates .1 Camden or BEA. .2 36" tall vertical actuation bar, high and low push plate. .3 Hardwired with 'push to open' text.
requirements.text: Automatic door opener push plates must be Camden or BEA, with 36" tall vertical actuation bar (high and low), hardwired with 'push to open' text.

requirements.paragraph: 3.1 Product Selection .1 Materials .16 Push Plates, Pulls and Protective Plates .1 Trimco/CBH/Gallery.
requirements.text: Push plates, pulls, and protective plates must be from Trimco, CBH, or Gallery.

requirements.paragraph: 3.1 Product Selection .1 Materials .17 Thresholds and Weather-Stripping .1 Pemko/Crowder/Zero.
requirements.text: Thresholds and weather-stripping must be from Pemko, Crowder, or Zero.

requirements.paragraph: 3.1 Product Selection .1 Materials .18 Station Controls and Key Switches .1 Von Duprin/LCN/RCI/Securitron .2 Camden CM-1030-7224 SPDT with red & green LED
requirements.text: Station controls and key switches must be from Von Duprin, LCN, RCI, Securitron, or Camden CM-1030-7224 SPDT with red & green LED.

requirements.paragraph: 3.1 Product Selection .1 Materials .19 Power Supplies .1 Use power supplies to match manufacturers’ equipment when required. .2 Power supplies require battery backup. .3 Locknetic/Folger-Adams, Securitron, Von Duprin, Yale/Corbin
requirements.text: Power supplies must include battery backup and be from approved manufacturers: Locknetic/Folger-Adams, Securitron, Von Duprin, or Yale/Corbin.

requirements.paragraph: 3.1 Product Selection .1 Materials .20 Electrified Strikes .1 HES/RCI/Adams Rite
requirements.text: Electrified strikes must be from HES, RCI, or Adams Rite.

requirements.paragraph: 3.1 Product Selection .1 Materials .21 Transfer Hinges –12 wire standard .1 McKinney with electro lynx, Stanley, Hager
requirements.text: Transfer hinges must be 12-wire standard from McKinney (with electro lynx), Stanley, or Hager.

requirements.paragraph: 3.1 Product Selection .1 Materials .22 Hard Wired Electrified Locksets .1 Manufacturers: Schlage, Corbin, Sargent [Manufacturers are currently under review] .2 Integral magnetic position indicator. .3 Handle integrated request to exit function .4 Integrated card / FOB reader (I-Class compatible)
requirements.text: Hard-wired electrified locksets must be from Schlage, Corbin, or Sargent and include integral magnetic position indicator, handle-integrated request to exit, and integrated I-Class compatible card/FOB reader.

requirements.paragraph: 3.1 Product Selection .1 Materials .23 Wireless Electrified Locksets .1 [Manufacturers are currently under review] .2 Non-proprietary battery supply only .3 Minimum 50,000 cycles per battery supply .4 Hard-wired power source option preferred .5 Dedicated Wireless network hardware or encrypted Wi-Fi
requirements.text: Wireless electrified locksets must use non-proprietary battery supply only and provide a minimum of 50,000 cycles per battery supply.

requirements.paragraph: 3.1 Product Selection .1 Materials .24 Electrified Exit Devices .1 Corbin/Sargent/Von Duprin (QEL series) .2 Electrified dogging required unless prohibited by code.
requirements.text: Electrified exit devices must be from Corbin, Sargent, or Von Duprin QEL series, with electrified dogging required unless prohibited by code.

requirements.paragraph: 3.1 Product Selection .1 Materials .25 Electrified Hold-Open Devices .1 Simplex RSG series or Edwards 1500 series. .2 Install hold-open devices for fire separation doors in corridors and other high use areas where occupants will likely use door stops to hold the doors open, thereby compromising the fire rating of the opening. .3 Concealed hold-opens within door closers are not acceptable. .4 Coordinate location of surface-mounted hold-opens with the supplier to ensure sufficient wall and floor clearances are maintained.
requirements.text: Electrified hold-open devices must be Simplex RSG series or Edwards 1500 series; concealed hold-opens within door closers are not acceptable.

requirements.paragraph: 3.1 Product Selection .1 Materials .26 Electrified Lock Boxes .1 ProxSafe flex key management system
requirements.text: Electrified lock boxes must be ProxSafe flex key management system.

requirements.paragraph: 3.1 Product Selection .1 Materials .29 Card Strikes / FOB Readers .1 Supplied and installed by UBC Access and Security Services where not integrated into the lockset. .2 Contractor to supply and install pathway installation only as indicated on drawings. .3 I-Class compatible
requirements.text: Card strikes and FOB readers must be I-Class compatible.

requirements.paragraph: 3.1 Product Selection .1 Materials .30 Fire Department Key and Card Tube Deposit Lockbox .1 All new buildings to have a tube-shaped Fire Department lockbox installed close to the main entrance. The lockbox lid is to be installed flush with the exterior wall surface. .2 Lockboxes shall be cored into concrete, installed horizontally and epoxied into place. A free-standing externally-located square-faced concrete post can be used if there is no adequate location on the exterior wall surface. .3 Construction of key-deposit housing to be steel. .4 Cylinder housing to be hardened steel. .5 Sleeve size to be: 180 mm long x 63 mm diameter or 7 inches long x 2.5 inches diameter. .6 Manufacturer to be Abloy Key and Card Tube Deposit Lockbox – Abloy Protec.
requirements.text: Fire department lockbox sleeve size must be 180 mm long x 63 mm diameter or 7 inches long x 2.5 inches diameter.

requirements.paragraph: 3.1 Product Selection .1 Materials .30 Fire Department Key and Card Tube Deposit Lockbox .3 Construction of key-deposit housing to be steel. .4 Cylinder housing to be hardened steel.
requirements.text: Fire department lockbox key-deposit housing must be steel and cylinder housing must be hardened steel.

requirements.paragraph: 3.1 Product Selection .1 Materials .30 Fire Department Key and Card Tube Deposit Lockbox .6 Manufacturer to be Abloy Key and Card Tube Deposit Lockbox – Abloy Protec.
requirements.text: Fire department lockbox manufacturer must be Abloy Protec (Abloy Key and Card Tube Deposit Lockbox).

requirements.paragraph: 3.2 Finish .1 Brushed stainless steel.
requirements.text: Fire department lockbox finish must be brushed stainless steel.
